name: Cable Bent Over Bar Pullover
cardText:
Cable Bent Over Bar Pullover
Beginner
1
You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
3
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

name: Cable Pull In
cardText:
Cable Pull In
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
2
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
3
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Cable Lat Prayer
cardText:
Cable Lat Prayer
Advanced
1
You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
3
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
cardText:
Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
Beginner
1
Stand between high cables, holding the handles in each hand.
2
Pull both elbows downward and inward toward your sides.
3
Squeeze your lats, then slowly extend your arms outward.

name: Cable Standing Bilateral Straight Arm Pull In
cardText:
Cable Standing Bilateral Straight Arm Pull In
Beginner
1
Stand between high cables with both arms extended outward.
2
Pull the handles downward and inward while keeping your elbows nearly straight.
3
Squeeze your lats, then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In
Novice
1
Kneel in between high cables, holding the handles.
2
Face forward with palms facing upward.
3
Pull your elbow in toward your rib cage, extend your elbow, then pull with the other arm.

name: Cable Kneeling Bilateral Pull In
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Bilateral Pull In
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
2
Kneel in the middle of the cable crossover.
3
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Cable Kneeling Straight Arm Pull In
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Straight Arm Pull In
Beginner
1
Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
2
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Straight Arm Pull In
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Alternating Straight Arm Pull In
Beginner
1
Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
2
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage. Alternate sides with each rep.

name: Cable Push Pull
cardText:
Cable Push Pull
Beginner
1
Stand between cables, holding one handle near your chest and one forward.
2
Press one arm forward while pulling the opposite elbow backward.
3
Reverse the movement under control, then switch your stance and arms.

name: Cable Single Arm Lat Prayer
cardText:
Cable Single Arm Lat Prayer
Advanced
1
Use handle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ear should be even with your arms.
3
Initiate the movement with your shoulder and not your elbow. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Cable Pull Around
cardText:
Cable Pull Around
Novice
1
Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
2
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
3
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
4
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.

name: Cable Kayak Row
cardText:
Cable Kayak Row
Beginner
1
Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
3
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Bring one arm to your side.
4
You can either alternate sides or do one side at a time.

name: Cable Rope Pullover
cardText:
Cable Rope Pullover
Beginner
1
Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
3
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

name: Cable Rope Lat Prayer
cardText:
Cable Rope Lat Prayer
Intermediate
1
Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
2
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
3
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Cable Straight Arm Pull In
cardText:
Cable Straight Arm Pull In
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
2
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
3
Face your palm forward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Cable Archer Row
cardText:
Cable Archer Row
Intermediate
1
Place the cable at shoulder height.
2
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
3
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.

name: Cable Supinating Row
cardText:
Cable Supinating Row
Beginner
1
Place the cable at shoulder height.
2
Start with an overhand grip. As you pull your elbow back, rotate your palm until it faces upward.

name: Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row
cardText:
Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row
Novice
1
Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm toward the midline of your body.
2
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
cardText:
Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
Novice
1
Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm upward.
2
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.
